source.title: On Fate's Path
source.description:
Caldoran used a combination of holy magic, skilled craftsmanship, and ambition to "cleanse" the blade.  The Ashbringer ultimately rejected Caldoran, but some of his methods may have some merit as a place to start.

Light and darkness are the sum of what the Ashbringer is now and the lightforged weapons wielded by the crusaders in the  Enclave may be of use to us.
source.completion:
The methods of the Scarlet Crusade are as twisted as they are misguided.  The arms and armor of the crusaders shine with radiant light, but also reflect the inherent darkness of the Scarlet Crusade. The inherent duality of this lightforged metal makes it well suited to reforging the blade.

Only one component remains.
